get.summary: Quantitative stats for a user (XP, missions, campaigns, …) with date/period filters
get.description: Aggregates the user's activity. Use `period` (weekly|monthly|annual) for a rolling window, or `startDate`/`endDate` for a custom range (these override `period`). Omit all for all-time totals.

post.summary: Follow a user (feeds your following/home timeline)

post.description: Spends coins to buy one Streak Shield — a consumable that absorbs one missed day on your next login, cancelling that day's 3x streak decay. Self only (403 otherwise). 409 if you already hold the max; 422 if your balance is insufficient.

get.description: Case-insensitive substring search on username. Usernames aren't unique, so results may include several people with the same display name — the client resolves the one the user picks to its `id` (uuid) and sends that uuid in `mentions` on POST/PATCH /feed.

get.summary: Activity summary for the logged-in user (missions, specialties, coins, rewards)
get.description: Counts for the logged-in user in a São Paulo calendar bucket: `completedMissions` by difficulty, `completedSpecialties` by specialty, `coins` earned (denomination split) and `rewards` received via /rewards (xp + denarius). `period`: today | weekly | monthly | annual | all (default all).

post.description: Admins can create missions that are immediately active. Users ranked Tribune I or equivalent (Patrícios track) submit missions that require 3 approvals from other Tribune I+ users before going live.

get.summary: List missions for the logged-in user (filterable, paginated)
get.description: Returns missions from the user's main specialty and cross-related specialties, each tagged with its status. Filter by status, difficulty, type and track. Paginated.

schema.title: Professionid

parameters.description: Only missions of this active profession (422 if not chosen)

post.description: A Tribune I+ user (or admin) endorses a pending user-created mission. After 3 distinct approvals the mission goes live. The original creator cannot approve their own submission.

A Tribune I+ user (or admin) rejects a pending user-created mission. After 3 distinct rejections the mission is marked 'rejected' and never published. The original creator cannot reject their own submission.

get.description: Returns user-submitted missions in 'pending_approval' state. Only admins and Tribune I+ users can access this list. Each item shows how many approvals it has received and whether the viewer has already approved it.

schema.title: Response List Pending Creation Api V1 Missions Pending Creation Get

post.description: Creates an IN_PROGRESS record in user_missions for the logged-in user.

Drops a mission the logged-in user already started (IN_PROGRESS) or whose completion is still under review (PENDING_REVIEW). The mission returns to `available` and frees the daily/weekly slot it was holding. No XP is affected.

post.summary: Request completion of an in-progress mission (with evidence)
post.description: Opens the review window (PENDING_REVIEW) instead of completing immediately. If the mission requires proof (proof_type), the matching evidence (link / image_key / text) must be supplied; it is stored for peer/AI validation.

post.summary: Approve a peer's pending medium/hard mission completion
post.description: A user ranked above the executor (up to two ranks above) validates a pending medium/hard mission. One approval halves the remaining review window; 2 approvals finalize it immediately.

post.summary: Reject a peer's pending medium/hard mission completion
post.description: A same-legion validator ranked 1–2 above the executor rejects the evidence; the mission returns to IN_PROGRESS so the executor can resubmit. Clears the review window and any prior approvals. A `reason` of at least 20 characters explaining the rejection is required (422 otherwise).

get.summary: Missions awaiting the logged-in user's peer approval
get.description: Pull queue of pending medium/hard mission completions this user may validate: same legion as the executor, rank 1–2 above, window still open, not yet approved by them.

post.description: Called by the client after the user finishes watching a rewarded ad. Grants 2 extra daily mission slots (up to 3 video(s) per day). Returns 409 if the daily video limit has already been reached.

get.description: Called by Google AdMob after the user completes a rewarded video. Verifies ECDSA-SHA256 signature against AdMob's public keys. `custom_data` must contain the user UUID (set via ServerSideVerificationOptions in the mobile SDK). Returns 200 OK on success — required by AdMob to confirm delivery.

schema.description: User UUID — set by mobile client (absent in AdMob URL verification test)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream for mission status updates
get.description: Keep-alive SSE connection. Authenticate via ?token=<access_token> (EventSource cannot set Authorization headers on all platforms). The server pushes `mission_updated` events when a mission the user submitted is approved, rejected, or finalized. A `: ping` comment is sent every 30 s to keep the connection alive.

delete.description: Removes the user's SSE connection from the registry. Call this on logout so the server releases the queue immediately instead of waiting for the next ping timeout.

get.summary: List available missions for the logged-in user (paginated)
get.description: Returns only the missions the user has not started or completed yet — already-completed and in-progress missions are excluded so none repeat. Paginated.

get.summary: List the missions best matched to the logged-in user (paginated)
get.description: Ranks the user's available missions by how well they match the pattern of missions the user has completed — specialty, activity theme (tags), difficulty and type. Each item carries a `score` (0..1), `reasons` (PT-BR) and `matched_tags`. Capped by the remaining daily/weekly allowance. `personalized=false` when the user has no completion history yet (falls back to the default ordering).

get.summary: Day briefing: suggested missions + goal + streak + active bonus in one call
get.description: Aggregates the logged-in user's day: `suggested_missions` (top picks, universal catalog leads), `goal` (remaining daily/weekly + resets + rewarded video), `streak` and `active_bonus`. `suggestions` (1–10, default 3) sets how many missions to include.

get.summary: Get a single mission's current status for the logged-in user
get.description: Live status of one mission (available | in_progress | pending_review | completed) with completable_at / remaining_seconds / approvals. Finalizes the mission on read if its review window already elapsed. Use this to poll a specific mission after /complete.

Paginated cosmetic catalog. `type` (default avatar) and `rarity` (legacy/epic/mythical/legendary) filters; `owned=true|false` narrows to owned / not-owned. Each item flags `owned`, `is_active`, `affordable`.

get.summary: List the assets the logged-in user owns
get.description: Filter by `type` and/or `rarity` (legacy/epic/mythical/legendary).

schema.title: Response List Owned Api V1 Assets Owned Get

post.summary: Buy a digital asset with coins
post.description: Spends coins (restricted/admin funds allowed for digital items). 409 if already owned, 422 if insufficient balance. Free assets cost nothing.
Activates this asset and deactivates the user's other assets of the same type.

get.summary: Get the logged-in user's coin balance
List the user's coin transaction history (filterable by type)
get.description: Paginated, newest-first. `type` filters by transaction type (earn|spend|purchase|transfer|adjust|refund); `referenceType` filters by what triggered it (mission, rank_up, medal, redemption, admin_signup, …). `amount` is the signed net for this user (+credit / −debit).

get.summary: List your physical redemption history (filter by status)

get.description: Paginated catalog. `type` filters by product type (apparel|drinkware|accessory|collectible|other). Each item's `affordable` compares the price against your unrestricted balance.

post.summary: Redeem coins for a physical product
post.description: Spends coins from your UNRESTRICTED balance only — restricted (e.g. admin) funds cannot buy physical goods. 422 if you lack enough unrestricted coins.

post.summary: Grant an XP or coin reward
post.description: Distributes XP or coins (`type`: 'xp'|'coins', `amount` in XP points or denarii). Rewards the logged-in user by default; admins may target another user via `user_id`. Common users: max 100 per request (422) and 10 grants per SP day (429). Admins are uncapped.

get.description: Rewards used and remaining for the logged-in user in the current São Paulo day. Admins report null limits (unlimited).

get.summary: List daily rewards with the logged-in user's progress today
get.description: Paginated (`{ page, perPage, totalItems, language, items }`). `lang` (pt-BR|en, default pt-BR) localizes `name`/`description`. Each item carries `actions_done_today`, `claimed_today` and `claimable` (= min(actions, max_per_day) − claimed) for the current São Paulo day.

post.description: Grants the reward for actions performed today, up to the per-day cap. `count` (optional) claims fewer than all available. 409 if nothing is claimable (no qualifying actions yet, or cap reached).

get.description: Balance, recent movements, the active Estandarte (if any) and the standard catalog with affordability against the cofre balance.

post.summary: Donate coins to your legion's cofre
post.description: Members only. Spends your UNRESTRICTED balance (restricted/admin grants can't be donated). `amount` is in `unit` (aureus|denarius|as).
The legion leader (Centurião) or an admin spends the cofre on a temporary XP buff for the whole legion. 409 if a standard is already active or the cofre lacks funds.

get.description: Returns feed events newest-first. `scope` = home (default) | global | legion | province | following. **home** = global + your legion + people you follow. **following** = only people you follow. For legion/province, omit the id to use the logged-in user's own. Pass the returned `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

Returns visible posts tagged with `{tag}`, newest-first. The tag is normalized like stored hashtags (a leading `#` is optional, case-insensitive). Same audience visibility and FeedItem shape as `GET /feed`. Pass the returned `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

get.summary: Global search — users, hashtags and posts
get.description: Searches by a single term `q` across three sections in one call: users (username substring match), hashtags (#tag substring match, ranked by post count) and posts (body substring match). Posts respect the same audience visibility rules as GET /feed — only global posts or posts scoped to the requester's own legion/province are returned. `limit` caps each section independently.

patch.summary: Mark a single notification as read
Mark all of the user's notifications as read

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream for real-time notifications
get.description: Keep-alive SSE connection. Authenticate via ?token=<access_token>. The server pushes `notification_new` events the instant a notification is created for you (comment/reaction/mention, mission approved/rejected/finalized, rank up, medal earned, new follower). Every notification is written to the notifications table regardless of connection state — this stream is a best-effort real-time shortcut on top of that, not the source of truth. A `: ping` comment is sent every 30 s to keep the connection alive.

UserSummaryResponse.title: UserSummaryResponse
UserSummaryResponse.description:
Activity counts for the logged-in user over a period bucket (SP timezone).

Keys are stable: `completedMissions` always carries easy/medium/hard;
`completedSpecialties` every specialty; `coins` the denomination ladder
(aureus/denarius/as); `rewards` xp + denarius. Missing values are 0.
